correctness.rationale: PASS: For every prime p, b>=2, G=C_(p²)⊕C_(p^b), square-zero T iff imT⊆kerT; for every H⊆G with imT=H the map factors bijectively through a surjection G/H→H. Partition subgroup images into trivial, cyclic p, cyclic p², cyclic p^j (j>=3), and rank-two C_p⊕C_(p^j) types. The proof classifies rank-two possible subgroups as pC_(p²)⊕p^(b-j)C_(p^b), 1<=j<=floor(b/2), and computes surjections by reduction modulo p and higher-digit lift counts. For larger cyclic j, its intersection formula |H+p^tG|=p^(b-t+L_t) yields a difference of two homomorphism cardinalities and explains the exact thresholds 2j<=b, 2j=b+1, 2j=b+2, above zero. The closed image spectrum sums to (2p²−1)p^(b/2+1) for even b and (3p−2)p^((b+3)/2) for odd b. Independent generated-and-classified square-zero matrix endomorphisms reproduce full image histograms in nine cases (p,b): (2,2..6),(3,2..4),(5,2), with no use of the subgroup formula. This is finite corroboration, not the all-prime proof.
residual_risks: Applies to all primes p but only G=C_(p²)⊕C_(p^b), b>=2, abstract image isomorphism types of labeled maps; not orbits, higher ranks, or nilpotency index>2.
Machine calculations corroborate only stated finite domains; all-degree/all-prime claims depend on mathematical proofs.
